transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

Hello, doctor. I get this overwhelming, out-of-proportion fear whenever I even think about driving over certain bridges or high stretches of road. It has just gotten to be too much for me to handle on my own.
When you're not near bridges or high roads, do you have recurring thoughts or mental rituals that you feel compelled to do to reduce anxiety?
No, I don't really experience anything like that. I haven't noticed having any recurring thoughts or mental rituals when I'm away from those bridges and high roads.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were ["F40.2", "F41.0", "F42"], but based on this conversation, F41.0 (generalized anxiety disorder or panic disorder) and F42 (obsessive-compulsive disorder) seem unlikely because the patient denies recurrent anxiety outside of specific situations and denies any obsessions or compulsions. The symptoms are limited to an intense, circumscribed fear of specific situations (bridges and high roads), which is most consistent with F40.2 (specific phobia, situational type).
